model_family_specific_notes.rationale: Tree-based models (XGBoost, Random Forest) are invariant to monotonic transformations and scaling. Skewness correction and RobustScaling are primarily beneficial for linear/distance-based models but kept in the single pipeline for consistency unless a model-family-aware policy is activated.
Linear models require scaled, normally distributed, and non-collinear features for stable coefficient estimation and convergence.
